name: OBACT Oral Suspension 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About OBACT ORAL SUSPENSION

OBACT Oral Suspension is a probiotic supplement used to improve gut health, digestion and immunity. It works by restoring the balance of intestinal flora (healthy gut bacteria) which helps in the management of various gut disorders and vitamin deficiencies caused due to their imbalance.

It contains Bacillus clausii as the active ingredient. Bacillus clausii is a gut-friendly bacterium that supports the growth of healthy microbes in the gut while arresting the growth of harmful microbes. OBACT Oral Suspension is most popularly used to restore the gut health that is altered by gut infections, diarrhea or by the use of antibiotics or anti-cancer agents.

Take OBACT Oral Suspension as advised by your physician. It is for oral use only. Shake the medicine well before use. Before taking OBACT Oral Suspension, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding or having any pre-existing disease condition as a precaution. Do not exceed the stated recommended daily dosage. Do not take OBACT Oral Suspension if you are allergic to any of its ingredients.

name: HP Kit 1'S
introduction:
Introduction About HP KIT

HP KIT is a combination of Amoxicillin, Omeprazole, and Tinidazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-Helicobacter pylori drugs. It is used to manage infections caused by a bacteria called Helicobacter pylori, which is often found in the stomach of the affected individual. Infected patients are initially asymptomatic, with inflammation and ulceration developing later, causing abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, and upset stomach.

During the course of the management, your doctor might regularly monitor your condition to avoid any untoward side effects. HP KIT is not recommended for children younger than 1 year or weighing less than 10 kgs. Before taking HP KIT, inform your doctor if you have any blood disease, liver, kidney, or skin problems, fever, sore throat, swollen glands, or extreme tiredness.

HP KIT is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women, unless advised by your doctor. The most common side effects of taking HP KIT are decreased appetite, headache, diarrhoea, nausea, abdominal pain, skin rash, etc. Contact your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: It is used to manage Helicobacter pylori infections
usesDetails:
Uses Of HP KIT
It is used to manage Helicobacter pylori infections
mechanismOfAction:
How HP KIT Works

HP KIT decreases the amount of H. pylori and relieves gastric symptoms where amoxicillin inhibits certain proteins required in cell wall biosynthesis resulting in the death of the bacteria, omeprazole reduces the amount of acid produced by your stomach, and tinidazole releases certain chemicals that damage the bacterial DNA and causes cell death.
usageDetails:
How to use HP KIT

Take HP KIT as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of HP KIT for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: HP KIT is not recommended for use during the first trimester of pregnancy. HP KIT should be used during the second and third trimesters only if your doctor finds it necessary. Consult your doctor before taking it.
You should not breastfeed during and at least three days after completion of HP KIT> management. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or use any machines if you experience allergic reactions, dizziness, visual disturbances, or fits after taking HP KIT.
Avoid consumption of alcohol with HP KIT as it may increase the risk of getting side effects.
HP KIT should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems, patients not urinating regularly, and those about to have any urine test. Consult your doctor before taking it.
HP KIT should be used with caution in patients with severe liver problems or in those about to have any blood test for liver function. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take HP KIT if you are allergic to Amoxicillin, Omeprazole, Tinidazole, or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.
HP KIT is not recommended for children younger than 1 year or weighing less than 10 kg. Consult your doctor before taking it.
HP KIT should be used with caution in elderly patients as they may be at risk of getting liver side effects. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

HP KIT is not recommended for use if you:

Have or had any blood disease
Have organic neurological disorders
Are allergic to any other antibiotic

Before taking HP KIT, inform your doctor if you:

Ever had a skin reaction after taking a medicine used to reduce stomach acid
Have poor vitamin B12 (cobalamin) absorption
Are going to have a blood test (Chromogranin A)
Have osteoporosis (a bone problem)
Have glandular fever (fever, sore throat, swollen glands, extreme tiredness)
Are going to have oestriol tests (used during pregnancy to check the baby’s development)

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking HP KIT, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Medicines used for blood thinning (Ex. warfarin, acenocoumarol, dicoumarol, anisindione, phenindione, phenprocoumon)
Medicines used to manage fungal infections (Ex. ketoconazole, itraconazole, posaconazole, voriconazole)
Digoxin (used to manage heart problems)
Diazepam (used to manage anxiety, muscle cramps, or fits)
Phenytoin (used to manage fits)

Medicines used to manage gout (Ex. allopurinol, probenecid)

Overdosage:

Contact your doctor immediately if you or anyone else accidentally took too much of HP KIT. Symptoms of HP KIT overdose include nausea, vomiting, dizziness, stomach pain, diarrhoea, headache, depression, confusion, cloudy urine, and trouble urinating.

name: Evoxil HP Kit 1'S
introduction:
Introduction About EVOXIL HP KIT

EVOXIL HP KIT is a combination of Clarithromycin, Pantoprazole and Amoxicillin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics and Antiulcer agents. It is used to eradicate a bacteria called Helicobacter pylori in patients with active chronic gastritis, stomach and intestinal ulcers.

Along management with EVOXIL HP KIT your doctor might want you to make some lifestyle changes such as eating less spicy foods. Before starting the management with EVOXIL HP KIT your doctor might ask you to take some diagnostic tests to understand the existing condition.

Before taking EVOXIL HP KIT inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart disease. EVOXIL HP KIT should be taken with caution in patients having fungal infections, glandular fever, problems in urinating, joint pains and due to take Chromogranin A test.

EVOXIL HP KIT should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. The most common side effects of taking EVOXIL HP KIT are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, vomiting, indigestion and dry mouth. Talk to your doctor if any of these worsen or doesn’t improve.
uses: Eradicates Helicobacter pylori in patients with active chronic gastritis, stomach and intestinal ulcers
usesDetails:
Uses Of EVOXIL HP KIT
Eradicates Helicobacter pylori in patients with active chronic gastritis, stomach and intestinal ulcers
mechanismOfAction:
How EVOXIL HP KIT Works

EVOXIL HP KIT effectively eradicates H. Pylori and manages ulcers, where Clarithromycin which belongs to a group of medicine called macrolide antibiotics which enters the bacteria and stop its growth thus relieving the infection. Amoxicillin is a penicillin antibiotic which interferes with the important life cycle of the bacteria leading to its destruction. Pantoprazole is a selective proton pump inhibitor, which acts on the cells present in the lining of the stomach and reduces the amount of acid produced in the stomach.
usageDetails:
How to use EVOXIL HP KIT

Take EVOXIL HP KIT as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of EVOXIL HP KIT for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of EVOXIL HP KIT
Common
Headache
Nausea, vomiting
Abdominal pain
Diarrhoea, constipation
Indigestion, heartburn
Dry mouth
Benign polyps in the stomach
Skin rash, discomfort

warnings.details: EVOXIL HP KIT should be used with caution in pregnant women. Consult your doctor before taking it.
EVOXIL HP KIT should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy or disturbed vision after taking EVOXIL HP KIT.
EVOXIL HP KIT should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking EVOXIL HP KIT.
EVOXIL HP KIT is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease. It should be used with caution in patients with other liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking EVOXIL HP KIT.
Do not take EVOXIL HP KIT if you are allergic to Clarithromycin, Pantoprazole or Amoxicillin.

EVOXIL HP KIT is not recommended for use in patients having heart rhythm disorders. It should be used with caution in patients with heart problems such as heart failure, an unusually slow heart rate. Consult your doctor before taking EVOXIL HP KIT.

Others

Before taking EVOXIL HP KIT, inform your doctor if you:

Have fungal infections
Have glandular fever (sore throat, fever, swollen glands and extreme tiredness)
Have problems in urinating
Have joint pain
Are due to have blood test called Chromogranin A test
Have reduced Vitamin B12
Have rashes in areas exposed to sun

Use in Paediatrics:

Your child’s doctor will advise the correct dose and duration of EVOXIL HP KIT depending upon the child’s age, weight and disease condition.

Use in Geriatrics:

Your doctor will advise the correct dose and duration of EVOXIL HP KIT for you depending upon your age, disease condition and body weight.

Medicines used for thinning the blood (Ex. warfarin, dabigatran, rivaroxaban, apixaban)
Medicines used to lower blood glucose levels (Ex. nateglinide, pioglitazone, repaglinide, rosiglitazone, gliclazide, glimepiride, insulin)
Medicines used for management of cancer (Ex. vinblastine, erlotinib)
Immune suppressants (Ex. ciclosporin, sirolimus, tacrolimus) (used to manage organ rejection after transplant)
Medicines used in the management of HIV (Ex. ritonavir, efavirenz, etravirine, nevirapine, zidovudine, atazanavir, saquinavir)
Medicines used for management of certain bacterial infections (Ex. rifampicin, rifapentine, rifabutin, lincomycin)
Fluconazole, itraconazole, clindamycin, ketoconazole, itraconazole, posaconazole (used to manage fungal infections)
Medicines used for managing overactive bladder (Ex. tolterodine)

Herbal product used to manage depression (Ex. St John’s Wort)

Medicines used to manage gout (Ex. probenecid, allopurinol)

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of EVOXIL HP KIT, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital.

introduction:
Introduction About KABVIE 10 TABLET

KABVIE 10 TABLET is used in the management of Gastro-intestinal reflux disease (GERD), reflux or erosive esophagitis, heartburn, acidity, stomach ulcers and other complications caused due to excessive stomach acid secretions. It can also be used as an adjunctive therapy for eradication of Helicobacter pylori infection in combination with antibiotics (like amoxicillin and clarithromycin).

KABVIE 10 TABLET contains Vonoprazan which is a Potassium Competitive Acid Blocker (P-CAB). It works by blocking a specific protein in the stomach lining which is crucial for producing stomach acid. By inhibiting it, vonoprazan effectively reduces the amount of acid the stomach produces.

Vonoprazan reduces stomach acid more effectively than traditional proton pump inhibitors (PPIs), creating a less acidic environment which helps the antibiotics work better by increasing their stability and concentration in the stomach, making it easier to eradicate the H. pylori bacteria. KABVIE 10 TABLET is suitable for use only in adults.

Before taking KABVIE 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have low blood magnesium levels, calcium and potassium levels or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking KABVIE 10 TABLET are stomach pain, indigestion, diarrhea, constipation, bloating, high blood pressure, headache, changes in taste sense, vaginal yeast infection and cold-like symptoms. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How KABVIE 10 TABLET Works

KABVIE 10 TABLET contains Vonoprazan which works by blocking a specific protein in the stomach lining called the potassium ion transporter. This protein is crucial for producing stomach acid. By inhibiting it, vonoprazan effectively reduces the amount of acid the stomach produces. This helps in managing conditions like acid reflux, stomach ulcers, and other acid-related disorders by allowing the stomach and esophagus to heal.

For H. pylori infection eradication, vonoprazan is used as part of a combination therapy with antibiotics. Vonoprazan reduces stomach acid more effectively than traditional proton pump inhibitors (PPIs), creating a less acidic environment. This enhanced acid suppression helps the antibiotics work better by increasing their stability and concentration in the stomach, making it easier to eradicate the H. pylori bacteria and promote healing of the stomach lining.

Take KABVIE 10 TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight, and health condition. Do not stop taking KABVIE 10 TABLET without consulting your doctor.

Along management with PANTOP HP KIT your doctor might want you to make some lifestyle changes such as eating less spicy foods. Before starting the management with PANTOP HP KIT your doctor might ask you to take some diagnostic tests to understand the existing condition.

Before taking PANTOP HP KIT inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart disease. PANTOP HP KIT should be taken with caution in patients having fungal infections, glandular fever, problems in urinating, joint pains and due to take Chromogranin A test.

PANTOP HP KIT should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. The most common side effects of taking PANTOP HP KIT are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, vomiting, indigestion and dry mouth. Talk to your doctor if any of these worsen or doesn’t improve.

introduction:
Introduction About OMECER KIT

OMECER KIT is a combination of Amoxicillin, Omeprazole, and Tinidazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-Helicobacter pylori drugs. It is used to manage infections caused by a bacteria called Helicobacter pylori, which is often found in the stomach of the affected individual. Infected patients are initially asymptomatic, with inflammation and ulceration developing later, causing abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, and upset stomach.

During the course of the management, your doctor might regularly monitor your condition to avoid any untoward side effects. OMECER KIT is not recommended for children younger than 1 year or weighing less than 10 kgs. Before taking OMECER KIT, inform your doctor if you have any blood disease, liver, kidney, or skin problems, fever, sore throat, swollen glands, or extreme tiredness.

OMECER KIT is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women, unless advised by your doctor. The most common side effects of taking OMECER KIT are decreased appetite, headache, diarrhoea, nausea, abdominal pain, skin rash, etc. Contact your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.

It is used to manage Helicobacter pylori infections

How OMECER KIT Works

OMECER KIT decreases the amount of H. pylori and relieves gastric symptoms where amoxicillin inhibits certain proteins required in cell wall biosynthesis resulting in the death of the bacteria, omeprazole reduces the amount of acid produced by your stomach, and tinidazole releases certain chemicals that damage the bacterial DNA and causes cell death.

OMECER KIT should be used with caution in patients with severe liver problems or in those about to have any blood test for liver function. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take OMECER KIT if you are allergic to Amoxicillin, Omeprazole, Tinidazole, or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.
OMECER KIT is not recommended for children younger than 1 year or weighing less than 10 kg. Consult your doctor before taking it.
OMECER KIT should be used with caution in elderly patients as they may be at risk of getting liver side effects. Consult your doctor before taking it.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking OMECER KIT, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Medicines used for blood thinning (Ex. warfarin, acenocoumarol, dicoumarol, anisindione, phenindione, phenprocoumon)
Medicines used to manage fungal infections (Ex. ketoconazole, itraconazole, posaconazole, voriconazole)
Digoxin (used to manage heart problems)
Diazepam (used to manage anxiety, muscle cramps, or fits)
Phenytoin (used to manage fits)
Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. rifampicin, clarithromycin, tetracycline)
Medicines used to manage HIV (Ex. atazanavir, nelfinavir, saquinavir)
Tacrolimus (used after organ transplantation to manage rejection)
Methotrexate (used to manage arthritis or psoriasis)
St John’s wort (used in depression)
Cilostazol (used to manage intermittent claudication)
Clopidogrel (used to manage blood clots)
Erltinib (used in certain cancers)
Medicines used to manage inflammation and immune reactions (Ex. hydrocortisone, prednisolone)
Medicines used to manage gout (Ex. allopurinol, probenecid)

Overdosage:

Contact your doctor immediately if you or anyone else accidentally took too much of OMECER KIT. Symptoms of OMECER KIT overdose include nausea, vomiting, dizziness, stomach pain, diarrhoea, headache, depression, confusion, cloudy urine, and trouble urinating.
